text:
maria_am: Solaris wants to move a small POC from CompetitorY to Redwood next Monday. They sent a short checklist: pricing for ~10M tokens/month, exact header passthrough behavior for legacy auth, streaming chunk framing compatibility, JSON key order + whitespace differences, completed security questionnaire, and signed invoice detail for auditors. Can we triage blockers today?

devin_se: I can cover pricing + streaming. Quick answer on price: their volume fits our mid-tier; propose a one-month trial credit (we usually do 40% for mid-size POCs). About streaming: CompetitorY uses tiny binary-framed packets (length-prefixed). Our stream is newline-delimited SSE. We can add a temporary adaptor that emits length-prefixed frames to match their client. Need to benchmark - might add ~10-25ms per chunk.

nina_cs: I've asked Solaris for their sample requests/responses and the filled security questionnaire. Asked them to redact secrets but include exact header list they rely on. They want our answers back by Friday COB.

tariq_sece: Security notes: Data residency OK — Dedicated in us-west or Private deployment. For KMS: customer-managed keys are available only on Private and enterprise Dedicated with contract. We do not keep raw request bodies by default; if they require full-body retention for auditing we need CISO + legal signoff and additional controls. For the questionnaire we can reuse our SOC2/ISO artifacts; I'll draft targeted answers for the infra/network items.

ashley_legal: If Solaris wants per-request token logs attached to invoices we need an NDA + a data-export addendum. Also confirm if logs will include PII (even redacted). If yes, the legal team needs to review retention period.

devin_se: Regarding JSON parity: main differences we've seen are trailing whitespace and how stop sequences are handled. CompetitorY strips the stop token from the final message and collapses multiple newlines; we currently return everything verbatim up to the stop. Options: (1) add a route parameter emulate_competitory=true that post-processes outputs, (2) provide a small client-side shim/snippet to normalize, (3) run a compatibility proxy. I prefer (1) for POC speed.

tariq_sece: Header concerns: we by default drop cookie/session cookies and other secrets. We can pass-through headers on a whitelist per-route. Need Solaris to list exact header names (e.g., X-Client-Id, X-Trace-Id, Authorization). If Authorization passthrough is required and it's a customer-managed auth token, legal wants to review.

infra-bot: infra-bot: FYI rwd-canary-2 staging cluster available for smoke. Use namespace "solarispoc"; ephemeral credentials expire in 48h. Recommend running: 1) length-prefixed stream smoke, 2) compat_postproc on 20 prompts, 3) header pass-through smoke.

maria_am: Great. Solaris replied: they rely on X-User-ID and X-Session-Signature, and they round billing to 5-token buckets today. Also they need an invoice with line items per-route for audits.

devin_se: 5-token rounding is fine; explain rounding algorithm and provide tokenization sample for their prompts. For invoice granularity we can export per-route aggregated token counts and, under NDA, per-request logs. Will flag finance for invoice template.

nina_cs: Uploaded their questionnaire + sample traffic to presales drive: https://redwood.app/drive/solarispoc. Asked for the exact tokenization settings they use (model/codec, bucket rounding).

tariq_sece: I'll start the questionnaire draft and mark items requiring CISO/legal on the document. If they insist on customer-managed KMS for Hosted we need to push them to Private.

maria_am: Can someone pick up the temporary compatibility flag for stop-sequence emulation? We need a PR and a staging smoke-run by EOD tomorrow so I can send the POC SOW on Friday.

devin_se: I'll prototype a compat flag: frame_mode=competitory and stop_strip=true. Will add a short client snippet for quick verification. Expect a smoke branch by tomorrow morning.

ashley_legal: I'll standby to review NDA + data export addendum. Please include an example invoice PDF with the SOW.

infra-bot: infra-bot: smoke cluster creds provisioned at 1745551300. Logs will stream to /var/logs/solarispoc for 24h.

tariq_sece: Drafted the security responses (network, auth, key-mgmt) and linked in the drive. Nina, please attach the latest sample traffic so I can reference concrete header names.

nina_cs: Done. Also confirmed Solaris will accept a one-month trial credit. They asked for the POC endpoints and a test prompt set.

maria_am: Action items: Devin - compat flag PR + latency numbers. Tariq - questionnaire draft + KMS guidance. Ashley - NDA + invoice template. Nina - collect final header list and upload sample tokenization config. I'll compile SOW after smoke results. ETA: finalize POC SOW Friday noon.

maria_am: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the staging smoke. :rocket:
